glossary_additions: (14.2) jvalati = blazes (जल उठता है); of the firefly powder in 14.2.18 only, 'glows' (चमकता है); prajvālana = setting ablaze (प्रज्वलित करना), never 'burning up'
(14.2) leṇḍa = dung (लीद); kulīra = crab (केकड़ा); apasavya = anticlockwise (अपसव्य); pratīkāra = remedy (प्रतिकार) as in 14.4
(14.2) X-karaṇam = the making X: virūpa-karaṇa = the making misshapen (कुरूप करना), śvetī-karaṇa = the whitening (सफेद करना), śyāmī-karaṇa = the making dark-hued (श्याम करना)
(14.2) yoga in the 14.2 recipes (kṣud-yoga, kuṣṭha-yoga) = preparation (योग); NOTE a person must decide: 14.4 says 'compound', 12.4 'contrivance'; keep one rendering for Book 14 once decided
(14.2) kalka = paste (कल्क, masculine in Hindi: के कल्क); Hindi अग्नि is feminine; Hindi never uses a bracket or Latin letters
summary: 45 units reviewed; 28 units need a change, 42 issues (7 error, 35 minor), 41 machine-applicable patches. No regrouping: 28+29 stay one sentence (28 has no verb). Text flags: confirmed leṇda (6), piṣtena (10), kaṇgu (17), tvan (20, 22), ppatibalā (27), mukhyād (34), aṅgi/agni (31, accepted as only workable repair, still low); culluyāṃ (32) kept, but the second flag in 32 (pāyitā māṣā, visarga missing) is REJECTED because the sandhi is correct. Errors: 15 (Hindi commits to cock/man), 20 (Hindi 'burn up' for prajvālana), 27 (kalka wrongly split from the cooked oil, EN+HI), 31 (w kept misprint contrary to note), 32 (wrong flag), 38 not error but unmarked 'or' added. Other: Hindi कल्क/अग्नि/मणि gender, ālābu gender, invented identifications in glosses (39), abhiṣūya morphology (44, a person must decide), iti rendered 'thus' (45). Units 8, 9, 24, 41, 45 stay low/medium honestly; no firmer reading recommended. Drafter glossary suggestions: agree on jvalati=blazes (18 'glows'), leṇḍa=dung, kulīra=crab, apasavya=anticlockwise, X-karaṇam; yoga=preparation kept but conflicts with GLOSSARY 14.4 'compound' and 12.4 'contrivance': needs a person.
